item.title: Sharyland ISD approves election for $250 million bond
item.description: MISSION — The Sharyland ISD school board voted to call for a $250 million bond election in May with each member voicing strong support and a dire need to modernize the district, and to equip students and staff with the latest technology and an aquatic center.
